title: Batch p2-G01-1 (host.io, NRD feeds, SecurityTrails, Digital Asset Links, gov.br list)

attributes.official_android_apps: list of {package, sha256} Android apps the site delegates to through its Digital Asset Links statements (package name and SHA-256 signing-certificate fingerprints, upper-case colon form): the organisation's declared official apps, never proof that other apps are fake
attributes.asset_link_sites: web sites the domain's Digital Asset Links statements delegate to (handle_all_urls targets other than apps)
attributes.homepage_snapshot: provider snapshot of the domain homepage {url, ip, date, rank, title, server, links, source}: 'date' is when the provider scraped it, not the current state
attributes.related_domain_counts: number of domains sharing each value with the domain, per field {field: [{value, count}]} (host.io related: ip, ns, mx, asn, backlinks, redirects, adsense, googleanalytics, gtm...)
attributes.redirect_relations: dated redirect relations of the domain [{from, to, observed_at, date_source}]: date_source 'hostio_web_date' (homepage scrape date) or 'fetch' (date V3LUM read the reverse-redirect list)
attributes.ip_registration_info: registration and geo facts of the domain's addresses as reported by a provider {ip: {country, region, city, asn, as_name, route}}: registry data, never proof of physical location
attributes.shared_tracking_ids: tracking ids of the domain seen on more than 50 domains (agency, CMS or platform ids, P061): never a same-owner link
attributes.dns_history_a: historical A records of the domain from a DNS-history provider [{ip, first_seen, last_seen, organizations}]: past resolution, never current infrastructure
attributes.origin_ip_candidates: historical non-CDN addresses of a CDN-fronted domain [{ip, first_seen, last_seen}]: origin-IP hypotheses, unconfirmed until passive evidence shows the address serves the site now
attributes.subdomain_count: number of subdomains a provider reports for the domain (may exceed the names returned)
attributes.nrd_first_seen: date the domain first appeared in a newly-registered-domain list (list date; WhoisDS names are 24-48 h old at publication): approximate registration time
attributes.nrd_hits: matches of the org-profile brand or domain in newly registered (WhoisDS) and in-release (registro.br) lists [{domain, source, list_date, protected, technique, score, confirmed, confirmation, severity, tags}]
attributes.nrd_coverage: NRD list coverage of one run {whoisds_days, newest_list, missing_days, registrobr_window, registrobr_generated_at, stale, wording}: what 'not found' covers
attributes.release_window: registro.br release-process window of the list that names the domain {start, end, generated_at}: the name may have been re-registered since
attributes.official_gov_br: exact match in the SISP official gov.br domain list {domain, registrant_cnpj, registrant, created, updated, list_date}: official status of this exact name only, never of URLs or subdomains on it
attributes.govbr_parent_listed: listed gov.br parent of a subdomain in the SISP list: context only, no official status for the subdomain
attributes.govbr_domains: gov.br domains registered by the CNPJ in the SISP official list (the registrant is often the IT operator, not the agency)
attributes.keyword_domains: registered domains whose name contains the keyword (keyword search provider) [{domain, created, updated, is_dead}]: candidates to verify

tags.in_release: domain in the registro.br release process (expired, about to be released): re-registration risk, never 'newly registered'
tags.official_gov_br: exact domain listed in the SISP official gov.br domain list (federal government registration)
tags.cdn_origin_hypothesis: historical address of a CDN-fronted domain kept as an origin-IP hypothesis: unconfirmed, not current infrastructure
tags.shared_tracking_id: tracking id seen on more than 50 domains (agency or platform id): never a same-owner link (P061)

relations.linked_from: domain -> domain whose homepage links to it (backlink)
relations.redirected_from: domain -> domain whose homepage redirects to it (reverse redirect)
relations.copied_tracking_id: domain or tracking id -> non-own domain carrying an organisation tracking id (clone indicator, never a same-owner link)
relations.historical_a_record: domain -> IPv4 it resolved to in the past (DNS history, first/last seen): never current infrastructure
relations.official_android_app: domain -> Android package name the site delegates to (Digital Asset Links statement)
relations.app_signing_cert: domain -> SHA-256 fingerprint of the signing certificate of an Android app the site delegates to (Digital Asset Links)
relations.brand_match: brand keyword or own domain -> domain whose name matches it in a newly-registered, in-release or keyword-search list (lookalike candidate)

timeline.nrd_first_seen: first seen in a newly registered domains list
